reviews.t: With realistic expectations, these are a good buy.
reviews.x: Hoping to settle the dispute over whether these headbands are sized for adults or children. (Included pictures on my husband as we have similarly sized heads but he has no hair to get in the way.) I'm used to headbands hitting below my ears which these do not. If you agree that that is the proper way for a headband to fit, then these are best suited for children.  Since I just wanted something to keep my hair out of my eyes without sliding out constantly, these work fine for me. I used a pair of
I was so happy that I found these, I use to wear them years ago and was having problems finding these with the metal teeth, love these!!!!
They hang on throughout my day, running around after two young kids, gardening, cleaning, etc..

reviews.t: Nice quality, good fit and great price!
reviews.x: This are great. Was looking for a small thin headband that would hold down my new curly thick hair after chemo. The colors are great and the fabric is nicely wrapped on each one. They aren’t too tight but don’t slip off.  I did receive them with some of the metal teeth bent but that was probably because they stacked them all together for shipping.  It was an easy fix.  Simply adjust the teeth.  That’s one of the features I like.  Since my scalp is sensitive, I can move the teeth so they don’t to

These headbands aren't bad. I kind of thought they would be better made, but I'm not too disappointed, they tend to stay in place most of the time. The different types of colors are great. One good thing is they're bendable, it makes it easier to adjust for comfort or tightness.  Update 12/02/2020. I had given this headbands 3 stars, but now I'm switching it to 1 star. The cloth material started to come undone after 3 uses. The material is glued on, once the ends start coming undone the material
These have metal teeth that you can bend to shape to your head. And they’re super cute! LOVE them!
I like metal comb hair bands. These are comfortable and didn’t pull my hair causing breakage.

reviews.t: Keeps your hair, with color, away from your face!
reviews.x: When you want your hair out of your face, they’re great! Great color choices!

I have an unusually big (some would say, fat) head, and relatively fine hair that I like to keep off my face. I can get a headache just from looking at most headbands. These aren't absolutely perfect, but by far the best I've found.  look like they're made for a child's head, but the wire-like metal is bendable to suit. They're also relatively unobtrusive when on. I've stepped on them, bent the teeth, bent them back into shape, and they've lived another day. Am ordering a second set.

I have a preschooler who hates me working on her hair now. Gone the days I could tie up her hair in neat ponytails or pretty braids. These are face-savers. Keeping that thin 4yo hair away from greasy food, glitter glue or ice cream. The metal teeth are good to keep the band on for some time so that I don't have to constantly replace it. She jumps, kicks and even wrestles with them on, they're good. And they're pretty enough that the fancy lady deems them worthy enough to wear.

When I write a review I like to wait to give a accurate review. This was purchased on May 4 2020 for my 90 year old grandmother who has long hair this product served it's purpose held her long hair back in place. She gives it 10 plus.

reviews.t: Need longer teeth on the headbands.
reviews.x: I have very thick hair.  My prior headband with longer teeth is quite old and needs replacing.  I need headbands that have longer teeth in order to help with keeping my hair down.  The teeth on these headbands are to short.
These are very cheaply made. When adjusting to fit your head, they still slide out. Having one in the hair during a rainfall and it rusted. They are so cheap, I refuse to give them to charity.

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for...
reviews.x: I am so happy to find these on Amazon. I had one similar for a long time and needed new ones. They are great for my thick wavy hair, stay in place and no headband disomfort! Thank you!
I wear these daily and they are GREAT! They stay in my hair, don't give me a headache. I will buy more when I need another color or lose one I use a lot.

reviews.t: These are great for fine hair

Lots of colors (need to make in metallics or neutrals), stay in place and most of all doesn’t give me a headache or hurt to wear all day!!
Can't give five stars cause they catch in had and are a bit rough on your head. Hold so much better than plastic bands.

reviews.t: The quality is horrible.  The material on the head bands is unraveling.  No way to fix them

reviews.x: I used to get these at Walmart all the time but it is just another thing no longer available except being forced to buy online. I MUCH prefer spending my money locally so I am providing jobs and keeping business taxes paid to our County but alas these too are gone. I give them a very high rating as they form to fit my head and I have always had a problem keeping a headband in my hair. These are fantastic

These arrived today and I was so excited to get them. The colors are great and they look good but are lighter weight than my original and much smaller. In the photos you can see comparison between my original and these. I'm a lot less excited now but will probably keep them because I NEED something as my old one is rusting after probably 10 years.

reviews.t: Nice modern colors in an unexpectedly high quality!
reviews.x: I was afraid the colors would be too basic or primary, but they are more mustard, coral and neutrals - which was very nice.  Alot of product for the the price! Also, having very thick hair which no plastic headband can hold, it's very nice to have the strong metal base and teeth while the ribbon wrap makes them gentler on your hair.

reviews.t: Like you're not even wearing a headband, they're that comfortable!  :)
reviews.x: I was leery of these headbands, having never worn anything with so much wire before.  But WOW!!  It's Like you're not even wearing a headband, they're that comfortable!  :)  My only complaint is that there aren't enough colors, like no real red, or purple, or navy,  But what I got I will wear constantly!  Thank you!  :)

I am growing in new hair from postpartum and I ordered these to help hold them down. However, when wearing these with a ponytail, sometimes the headband slides to the back. When it does, it’s really hard to untangle the wire from your hair. I’d end up taking my hair down just to get the headband out.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the headbands stay in place and hold hair securely.
Many reviewers praise the metal teeth and bendable design for comfort and adjustability.
Several reviewers highlight the great color choices and cute appearance.
Some reviewers find the headbands too small or the teeth too short, especially for thick hair or larger heads.
A few reviewers complain about cheap construction, including bent teeth, sliding out, and rusting.
